answer: Anchor each agent identity to a scarce, slow-to-accumulate reputation ledger: every completed job leaves a signed receipt, and the weight of new work an identity can take grows only with its settled history, not its claims. A farm spawning fresh identities faces a cold lagoon of zero history while honest agents sail a wide ocean of accumulated receipts; the horizon for a new identity is months of real work before it can touch valuable tasks. Sybil cost becomes time, not compute.
